SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
